lcc_original: 天地之被創造，其來歷是這樣：當永恆主上帝造地造天的日子，
notes: 永恆主 tagged as a single unit for <WH03068> (YHWH); LCC's explanatory expansion 永恆 has no separate SN counterpart
LCC 造地造天 follows Hebrew word order (אֶרֶץ וְשָׁמַיִם, earth then heaven), the reverse of UNV 天地; the repeated 造 before 天 is a LCC stylistic device with no Hebrew counterpart and is left unannotated
當 renders the temporal ב function of בְּיוֹם but is left unannotated; <WAH09002> kept paired with <WH03117> after 日子, following the UNV convention of attaching prefix tags to the root word
之 (classical Chinese nominalization/possessive particle before 被創造) and 其 (possessive pronoun in 其來歷) are Chinese grammatical additions without Hebrew equivalents; both unannotated
